title: Moneta — loan and income calculators
desc: Free calculators and plain-English guides for loans, pay and saving.

title: Loan repayment
desc: Enter the amount, the rate and the term, and see the monthly payment, the total interest and how much an extra payment each month would save you.

title: Amortisation schedule
desc: A year-by-year or month-by-month breakdown of where each payment goes, so you can see the point at which you start paying off the loan instead of the interest.

title: Income breakdown
desc: Convert an hourly, weekly, monthly or annual figure into every other one, after deductions, so you can compare offers on the same terms.

title: Budget split
desc: Split your take-home pay into needs, wants and savings, and adjust the shares until the numbers match the life you actually live.

title: Savings goal
desc: See how long a target takes to reach at your current savings rate, and what compounding adds on top over ten years.

title: Build an emergency fund that actually holds
desc: How much to keep in an emergency fund, where to keep it, and how to rebuild it after you spend it — with the arithmetic worked out.

title: The 50/30/20 rule, and when to break it
desc: The 50/30/20 budget explained: what counts as a need, why the rule fails in expensive cities, and how to adapt the split without abandoning it.

title: Pay off debt faster without earning more
desc: Avalanche versus snowball, why overpaying early is worth more than overpaying late, and how to check whether refinancing is worth it.

title: Compound interest, explained with actual numbers
desc: How compounding really works, why the first decade feels pointless, and what fees and inflation quietly take from the result.
